assertions.details: Found 33 tables: activity_logs, attachments, bill_of_material_items, bill_of_materials, cash_movements, categories, customers, expenses, finished_product_images, finished_products, finished_stock_movements, invoice_items, invoices, material_images, material_stock_movements, materials, model_images, model_variants, models, payments, production_consumptions, production_order_stages, production_orders, production_stages, purchase_items, purchases, quality_checks, refunds, sale_items, sales, supplier_payments, suppliers, workshop_settings

assertions.test: Workflow A: Purchase receipt updates stock & moving weighted average cost
Workflow A Idempotency: Duplicate purchase stock movement prevented by unique idempotency_key
Workflow B Reservation: Material reservation reduces available_qty without reducing physical on_hand_qty
Workflow B Completion: Only accepted QC units (4 of 5) enter finished stock with exact unit cost (10,000 DZD)
Workflow C & D1: POS sale deducts finished stock (4 -> 2) and sets invoice status to PARTIALLY_PAID (20,000 DZD remaining)
Invoice Immutability: Renaming/repricing product does not alter historical confirmed invoice line snapshots
Workflow D2: Second payment automatically transitions invoice to PAID with 0.00 DZD remaining
Workflow E: Partial return restocks finished product (2 -> 3), preserves original payment records, and updates status to PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
